geoScope.description: Precision tier the author chose. The indexer never stores more precision than the scope allows.

kind.description: activity: the community decides to do something, and the winning option can be followed (com.para.civic.followThrough). persuasion: make the case to change positions on the policy named in `subject`. forum: a public conversation for the place given by region, geoScope and geo, with no decision to follow. Existing records default to activity.

subject.description: The policy post a persuasion cabildeo is about.

minimumViewTier.description: Minimum tier required to view the cabildeo. Existing records default to public.

minimumParticipationTier.description: Minimum tier required to vote, delegate, or publish a position. Existing records default to signed_in.

voteVisibility.description: Controls how voter identity is exposed. Existing records default to public.

protectedAction.description: The community action this cabildeo asks its assembly to decide (approve a membership, recover ownership, amend governance, …). A claim only: it carries no authority by itself. The AppView grounds an authority event on this cabildeo only for membership.approve (member.activate) and owner.recover (owner.grant or owner.revoke), and only when the cabildeo names its community by board URI, has exactly two options (the first approves, the second rejects), is still the record version in which voting opened, and closed with a quorum and threshold met by members known from authority events. See com.para.community.authorityEvent evidence.

geoPoint.description: Geographic coordinates in E7 (degrees × 10⁷) for map placement.
